scripts.build:native: set CAPACITOR=1 && npx vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');(function rm(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())rm(p);else if(f.endsWith('.map')||f.endsWith('.apk')||f.endsWith('.exe')||f.endsWith('.blockmap'))fs.unlinkSync(p)}})('dist');fs.rmSync('electron/app',{recursive:true,force:true});(function cp(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const a=path.join(s,f),b=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(a).isDirectory()){fs.mkdirSync(b,{recursive:true});cp(a,b)}else fs.copyFileSync(a,b)}})('dist','electron/app');console.log('[native] stripped .map/.apk/.exe from dist; mirrored dist -> electron/app')"
scripts.electron:build: cd electron && npm run build && npx electron-builder build -c ./electron-builder.config.json -p never
scripts.electron:pack: cd electron && npm run build && npx electron-builder build --dir -c ./electron-builder.config.json
